item.title: How to change the user in Subversive (Eclipse SVN)
item.description:
Today we’ll learn how to change the user logged into Subversive, the Eclipse IDE plugin. Well, this guide can also be useful if you’ve changed or lost your username and/or password and can’t authenticate with the SVN Server. Unfortunately this plugin doesn’t provide a graphical interface so you can simply log off and log in again.

However, we can do this very simply. Anyway, enough rambling, let’s get straight to what matters.

item.title: Conio2.h Installation and Configuration
item.description:
I prepared this document for some colleagues who were having difficulty installing the Conio2.h package for the Dev-C++ IDE. This package includes a library with functionality for developing applications written in C/C++.

To continue with this guide, you need to have Dev-C++ installed.

First we should Download the Conio2.h package from SourceForge.

After downloading it, we should run the file with the “DevPak” extension.
